newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Shinyoung to support Donga Mutual shrs.
newsitem.headline: Shinyoung to support Donga Mutual shrs.

text.p: South Korea's Shinyoung Securities said on Thursday it would support the shares of Donga Mutual Savings and Finance Co to keep the shares from falling below the stock's subscription price.

South Korean securities regulations call for the underwriter of an initial public offering (IPO) to keep the stock from falling below the subscription price for six months after it starts trading on the stock market.

Shinyoung, along with Dongsuh Securities and Dongwon Securities, will place buy orders at Donga's subscription price of 8,000 won if the lower end of the stock's trading range for the day drops below that level, the statement said.
Donga shares, which began trading for the first time on Tuesday, closed Thursday's session at 8,310 won. Their lowest permissible price for Friday was set at 7,820 won.
